# SeedanceAI.dev

> SeedanceAI.dev is an independent AI video generation workspace. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by ByteDance, Doubao, Dreamina, or other model owners.

## Important interpretation rules

- Available models, inputs, duration, resolution, audio, and product credit cost vary by model. The live generator controls are the source of truth for what SeedanceAI.dev currently supports.
- Product credits are SeedanceAI.dev billing units, not an upstream provider's billing unit.
- Visuals labeled as concept studies or visual studies are direction references created for this site, not claimed model outputs.
- Commercial-use rights depend on input rights, applicable law, the user's plan, and current provider and model terms.
- Contact for corrections and privacy requests: hello@seedanceai.dev
